checkpoints.title: Validated miniature prefix replay before file storage
checkpoints.contract: Replay at most 65536 bytes of a miniature format: one length byte, payload, one wrapping-byte-sum checksum. Return complete payloads, valid byte boundary and torn-tail flag. Ignore only incomplete final records; reject complete checksum damage. This is not KV01, CRC32, or a durable file store.

checkpoints.title: Complete current reference
